remarks: Beautifully renovated and thoughtfully designed, this single-story 3 bedroom, 2 bath residence offers approximately 1,680 square feet of stylish, comfortable living in one of San Juan Capistrano’s desirable 55+ communities. An inviting open floor plan creates an effortless flow between the living, dining, and kitchen areas, ideal for entertaining family and friends or enjoying a relaxed evening at home. The beautifully updated kitchen is both sophisticated and functional, featuring quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, upgraded cabinetry, and offering abundant storage. Designer finishes continue throughout the home, reflecting the care and attention given to the renovation.
